overview: Client-side PLAY handler applying server state to WorldClient. Dispatches S00-S49 to world, GUI, scoreboard and entities via PacketThreadUtil. Replies with C00 keepalive, C03 pos-look ack, C0F confirm and C17 brand.

methods.detail: Builds WorldClient from gametype/dimension/difficulty. Sets maxPlayers, reducedDebug. Sends MC|Brand custom payload and client settings to server.
methods.name: handleJoinGame

methods.detail: Adds relative flags X/Y/Z/Y_ROT/X_ROT to player pos; zeroes motion on absolute axes. Replies C06 PosLook. First receipt sets doneLoadingTerrain and closes download screen.
methods.name: handlePlayerPosLook
methods.purpose: Applies server teleport and acks it.

methods.detail: Scales pos /32.0, yaw/pitch *360/256. Type switch: 10 minecart, 60 arrow, 1 boat, 70 fallingblock. Sets serverPos, entityId, velocity /8000.0 and adds to world.
methods.name: handleSpawnObject

methods.detail: If extractedSize==0 does preChunk unload. Else preChunk load, invalidate region, fillChunk, mark render update. Resets relight unless surface world with full chunk.
methods.name: handleChunkData
methods.purpose: Loads or unloads a chunk column.

methods.detail: Resolves inventoryContainer vs openContainer by windowId. If S32 accepted=false, replies C0F accepted=true to resync. No action on accepted.
methods.name: handleConfirmTransaction

methods.detail: If dimension differs clears doneLoadingTerrain, preserves scoreboard, creates new WorldClient, shows download terrain. Then setDimensionAndSpawnPlayer and game type.
methods.name: handleRespawn

methods.detail: level:// loads local file else checks ServerResourceMode. ENABLED auto-accepts, DISABLED declines, PROMPT shows GuiYesNo. Replies C19 ACCEPTED/DECLINED/SUCCESS/FAIL.
methods.name: handleResourcePack

methods.detail: MC|TrList sets villager recipes if windowId matches. MC|Brand sets clientBrand. MC|BOpen opens written-book GUI. Releases buffer after read.
methods.name: handleCustomPayload

methods_detailed.name: handleJoinGame
methods_detailed.detail_long: handleJoinGame processes S01 on the client thread via PacketThreadUtil and builds the initial WorldClient. It installs a new PlayerControllerMP, then constructs WorldClient from gameType, hardcore flag, world type, dimension, difficulty and profiler. It copies difficulty into gameSettings, loads the world, sets thePlayer dimension and shows GuiDownloadTerrain. It assigns the server entityId, stores maxPlayers in currentServerMaxPlayers and applies reducedDebug. It sets the controller gameType, pushes client settings to the server and sends C17 MC|Brand with ClientBrandRetriever mod name. No kick occurs here, the reply packets are C17 brand and settings. Failure to receive later S08 keeps the download screen up.
methods_detailed.code_walkthrough: checkThreadAndEnqueue hops S01 onto the main client thread before touching the world. The WorldClient constructor carries gameType, hardcore, world type, dimension and difficulty that define physics and rendering. loadWorld plus GuiDownloadTerrain blocks input until terrain and S08 arrive. setEntityId and currentServerMaxPlayers bind the local player to the server id and tab-list cap. The final C17 MC|Brand reply advertises vanilla or modded client to the server.

methods_detailed.name: handlePlayerPosLook
methods_detailed.detail_long: handlePlayerPosLook applies S08 server teleports and corrections on the client thread. It reads absolute X Y Z yaw pitch, then adds current player pos or rotation when relative flags X Y Z Y_ROT X_ROT are present. For absolute axes it zeroes motionX, motionY or motionZ to stop rubber-band sliding. It then calls setPositionAndRotation and immediately replies with C06 PacketPlayerPosLook using posX, bounding-box minY, posZ, yaw, pitch and false onGround. On first receipt when doneLoadingTerrain is false it snapshots prevPos, sets the flag true and closes the download screen. Later receipts just correct position without GUI change. No kick occurs, the only response is the C03 C06 ack which lets the server clear hasMoved.
methods_detailed.code_walkthrough: The X_ROT and Y_ROT flag checks add current pitch and yaw for relative look teleports. setPositionAndRotation applies the final merged coordinates and angles to the local player. The C06 reply carries bounding-box minY and false onGround so the server can validate the ack. The doneLoadingTerrain false branch fires once to initialize prevPos and dismiss GuiDownloadTerrain. Repeated S08 packets cause server-side teleport-backs that clients must ack to avoid movement freeze.

methods_detailed.name: handleSpawnObject
methods_detailed.detail_long: handleSpawnObject spawns S0E vehicles, projectiles and blocks in WorldClient. It scales network X Y Z by dividing by 32.0D to get block coordinates. It switches on type where 10 is minecart with subtype, 60 arrow, 61 snowball, 62 egg, 63 large fireball, 64 small fireball, 65 ender pearl, 66 wither skull, 71 item frame, 72 eye, 73 potion, 75 bottle, 76 firework, 77 leash, 78 armor stand, 1 boat, 2 item, 50 TNT, 51 crystal, 70 falling block and 90 fish hook. Fish hook resolves the thrower entity and resets data to zero, frames and leashes floor coords and reset data. After creation it copies serverPos, converts yaw and pitch with times 360 divided by 256, fixes multipart ids, sets entityId and adds to world. If data is positive it sets velocity divided by 8000.0D and links arrows to shooter living base.
methods_detailed.code_walkthrough: checkThreadAndEnqueue ensures spawning happens on the render thread. Dividing by 32.0D converts fixed-point network coords to doubles for accurate placement. The type 10 branch builds minecarts with network subtype for chest, furnace and TNT variants. The type 90 branch looks up the thrower player to attach the fish hook and clears extra data. Later code scales yaw and pitch by 360 over 256 and velocity by 8000, which cheats cannot spoof without server correction.

methods_detailed.name: handleChunkData
methods_detailed.detail_long: handleChunkData applies S21 chunk column load or unload on the client thread. If the packet is a full-chunk preChunk signal it checks extracted size, where zero means unload via doPreChunk false and return. Non-zero calls doPreChunk true to allocate the column. It then invalidates the 16 by 256 by 16 receive region, fetches the Chunk object and fills it with extracted bytes, size and full flag. It marks the block range for render update so lighting and meshes rebuild. If not a full chunk or the provider is not surface world, it resets relight checks to avoid stale skylight. Unloads free memory while loads populate blocks and biomes. No reply packet is sent.
methods_detailed.code_walkthrough: The func_149274_i gate distinguishes full-column init from delta updates. Zero extracted size with full flag means unload, so doPreChunk false drops the column. Non-zero calls doPreChunk true then fillChunk with the compressed byte payload. invalidateBlockReceiveRegion and markBlockRangeForRenderUpdate bracket the fill to refresh lighting and rendering. The surface-world check skips relight reset for nether and end where skylight differs.

methods_detailed.name: handleConfirmTransaction
methods_detailed.detail_long: handleConfirmTransaction processes S32 server inventory verdicts on the client thread. It resolves the target container by windowId, where zero means inventoryContainer and otherwise the openContainer only if ids match. Null containers from stale windows are ignored. If the packet reports accepted false via func_148888_e it replies with C0F confirm accepted true carrying the same windowId and action number. Accepted true packets need no reply because both sides agree. The C0F reply unlocks the server-side canCraft lock set by processClickWindow mismatch. This single round trip resyncs duped or ghost clicks. No kick or teleport occurs.
methods_detailed.code_walkthrough: checkThreadAndEnqueue moves the verdict to the main thread. The windowId zero versus openContainer match selects inventory versus chest, furnace or crafting table. Null from closed windows is dropped to avoid acting on stale ids. The not-accepted check via func_148888_e triggers a C0F with accepted true to acknowledge the server correction. That C0F carries windowId and action number so the server can clear field_147372_n and re-enable crafting.

methods_detailed.name: handleRespawn
methods_detailed.detail_long: handleRespawn rebuilds WorldClient on S07 dimension change or difficulty sync. It first compares packet dimension to thePlayer dimension to detect cross-dimension moves. On change it clears doneLoadingTerrain, preserves the old scoreboard, constructs a new WorldClient with gameType, hardcore flag, world type, dimension and difficulty, then loads it and shows GuiDownloadTerrain. It always calls setDimensionAndSpawnPlayer and setGameType from the packet even for same-dimension respawns. The scoreboard carry-over keeps teams and objectives across deaths. No reply packet is sent, the client waits for follow-up S08 position and S21 chunks. This explains respawn flicker and why mods must rebind world references.
methods_detailed.code_walkthrough: The dimension mismatch gate separates full world rebuild from same-world respawn. Clearing doneLoadingTerrain forces the next S08 to dismiss the download screen. Saving and restoring the scoreboard preserves teams across dimension travel. The WorldClient constructor with gameType and difficulty reapplies rules for the new dimension. The final setDimensionAndSpawnPlayer plus setGameType sync player controller even when no rebuild occurred.

methods_detailed.name: handleResourcePack
methods_detailed.detail_long: handleResourcePack implements S48 server pack prompt with C19 status replies. It extracts URL and hash, then branches on level slash slash prefix for local saves versus remote packs. Local files under saves are checked with isFile, replying ACCEPTED then async SUCCESSFULLY_LOADED or FAILED_DOWNLOAD, or immediate FAILED_DOWNLOAD if missing. Remote packs check ServerData resource mode where ENABLED auto-accepts and downloads, DISABLED replies DECLINED, and PROMPT schedules a GuiYesNo dialog. Confirming yes sets mode ENABLED, sends ACCEPTED and downloads, while no sets DISABLED and sends DECLINED. Downloads use the repository with Futures callbacks that send final C19 status. No kick occurs directly, but servers may kick on DECLINED.
methods_detailed.code_walkthrough: getURL and getHash provide the pack location and integrity hash for C19 replies. The startsWith level branch strips the prefix and resolves the file under the saves directory. isFile success sends C19 ACCEPTED immediately before async load. The Futures callbacks send SUCCESSFULLY_LOADED or FAILED_DOWNLOAD after the repository finishes. The missing-file else sends FAILED_DOWNLOAD, while remote ENABLED, DISABLED and PROMPT branches below handle server-hosted packs.

methods_detailed.name: handleCustomPayload
methods_detailed.detail_long: handleCustomPayload dispatches S3F plugin channels on the client thread. MC|TrList reads an int windowId, checks the current screen is GuiMerchant and ids match openContainer, then parses MerchantRecipeList and sets villager recipes. MC|Brand reads a string up to 32767 and stores it as clientBrand for server identification. MC|BOpen checks the held item is written_book and opens GuiScreenBook read-only. After TrList the buffer is released in finally to avoid leaks, other branches release via network layer. Unknown channels are ignored. No reply packet is sent, the data only mutates GUI and NBT state. Exploit angle is fake TrList with mismatched windowId which is correctly dropped.
methods_detailed.code_walkthrough: The MC|TrList equals gate isolates villager trades from brand and book channels. readInt plus GuiMerchant plus windowId match prevents injecting trades into the wrong container. readFromBuf and setRecipes populate the merchant GUI with server offers. The catch logs load failures while finally releases the buffer to prevent netty leaks. The MC|Brand branch stores the server brand string for F3 debug display.
